status: completed: one built-in call per layout, 2026-09-13

1x4.prompt:
Generate exactly ONE 1-row by 4-column sheet (1x4 rows x columns). Canvas aspect 2:1 landscape. Total sheet 192x96 implied logical pixels, partitioned into 4 frames of48x96. Four views of the SAME FEMALE, left to right: front, right side, back, left side.
Use case: style-transfer to a SPRITE SHEET of simulated pixel art. Input1 is the LOCKED sheet layout and pixelized Blender structure. Every frame is48x96 implied logical pixels INCLUDING its empty margins. Translate these coarse Blender blocks into finished simulated PIXEL ART while maintaining the same pixel scale: flat-colored square cells, deliberate chunky pixel clusters, stepped tonal ramps and crisp square boundaries visible BEFORE reconstruction. Face detail occupies only a few logical pixels. One uniform pixel grid and pixel size across ALL frames. This is a magnified tiny game sprite sheet; no subpixel material texture, anti-aliasing, blur, gradients or glow.
Input2 supplies ONLY the gritty realistic pre-rendered Diablo II sprite finish. Express that appearance through the coarse pixel clusters: believable adult anatomy, restrained shaded face planes, dark natural occlusion, earthy hide and linen colors, discrete upper-left highlights. Natural adult proportions, small shaded eyes, worn materials represented by compact tonal clusters. Keep the clothing and coloring from Input1. Adult female has fitted tan open vest over short ivory tunic, red-ochre cloth on ONE consistent anatomical shoulder, tied brown hair, bare athletic arms/lower legs, wrist bindings, low tan shoes. Male has short dark hair, brown hide vest, short ivory tunic, wrist guards, low brown shoes. All unarmed with low relaxed arms, natural narrow idle stance.
Preserve the elevated35-degree fixed game camera, silhouette, facing, placement and scale of every cell in Input1. The views are rotations of the SAME character, not different people or new costumes. Preserve anatomy, garment construction, hair, palette, shoulder-cloth side and lighting coherently across views. Face appears only in forward/side views; back view shows back of head and garments. Do not mirror one pose to invent another, widen stances, zoom individual cells or change frame order. Keep all characters whole, inside their individual frame rectangles, with clear empty separation. No props, labels, lettering, borders, dividers or additional sprites.
Background is one solid uniform olive-slate #737A68 color field, with that exact color excluded from character colors. No pattern, texture, shadow plate or floor.
